facts.fact: The National Payment Systems (Consumer Protection) Regulations, 2022 (S.I. 103), made by the Finance Minister on 12 July 2022 and gazetted 9 September 2022, set conduct, disclosure and complaint rules for payment licensees.
The regulations let a consumer unsatisfied with a licensee's decision lodge a complaint with the Central Bank, which must determine it within 21 working days and may order refund or compensation.
